user.title: Surf spot
user.description: Name and position of your spot. Place the pin on the water just off the beach.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Define when your spot is surfable. An hour counts when all conditions hold; consecutive hours form a session.

data.use_swell: Rate swell instead of total waves (ocean spots)
data.glassy_max: Clean-up: below this wind speed only the waves count

data_description.wind_dir_from: Direction the wind has to come FROM to build waves at your spot (0 = N, 90 = E). Clockwise from → to, e.g. 0 → 90 for wind from N to E.
data_description.wind_min: Wind needed to build or keep the waves.
data_description.wind_max: Above this it is blown out.
data_description.glassy_max: When the wind drops after a blow and the waves are still there, the hour counts regardless of direction.
data_description.swell_dir_from: Direction the waves have to come from (mean wave direction, clockwise from → to).
data_description.use_swell: Keep off for wind-driven seas like the Baltic.
data_description.notify_service: Leave empty if you only use the surf_forecast_session event / blueprint.

error.no_marine_data: No wave data for this location. Move the pin a bit further out to sea.
error.wave_range: Maximum wave height must be greater than the minimum.
error.corridor_incomplete: Set both corridor bounds or both to -1.
error.notify_service: The service must start with notify.
error.wind_range: Maximum wind must be greater than minimum wind.
